metric_note: ensemble AUROC/AUPR; other mean metrics are per-seed means; no bootstrap

feature_definitions.H_JS: formal full-visual-support JS, not Union-Top32 JS
feature_definitions.I: sum_m ||a_m||_2 = sum_m saved write_mag_m (gross WRITE, not ||sum_m a_m||)
feature_definitions.N: saved net_strength = ||G(z)-G(z0)||_2; finite quadrature need not sum exactly to this
feature_definitions.R_cos: formal old_hpre_cos source / hpre_raw_logit_gauss target / sqrt_matched_state OT
feature_definitions.U: concatenate [R_cos, AE, S, kappa]; exactly H with all three distances removed
feature_definitions.kappa: saved N/S (zero on degenerate gross); no clipping/recalibration

protocol.inference_boundary: No VLM forward; MLP training only; same test cohort, exploratory
